Research Notes on Planetary Periods

Dasha systems are a key component of Jyotish timing analysis.
The Vimshottari Dasha system divides the 120-year cycle into planetary periods.

Each dasha period has sub-periods (bhukti) that provide more detailed timing.
The dasha sequence follows the order of Vimshottari years for each planet.

Planetary strength (bala) is assessed using multiple methods.
Shadbala provides sixfold strength assessment of planets.

Ashtakavarga is a points-based system for assessing planetary strength.
Each planet contributes points based on its position relative to other planets.

 yogas are specific planetary combinations that produce particular effects.
Raja Yoga indicates potential for success and prominence.
